events.name: Free Reward Wheel
events.intro: A promoter waves you over to a wheel with its odds painted on it. It is free, no tickets, no catch.

choices.label: Small wheel: 80% win ₽300, otherwise a Dire Hit
Gold wheel: 25% win a Rare Candy, otherwise ₽100

success.text: The wheel stops on gold: a Rare Candy!
You leave it be and walk on.
